title: Checkpoint
description: Immutable snapshot of execution state at a point in time, addressable for resume or as the source of a fork.

metadata.description: Optional non-authoritative producer or storage metadata; it is not covered by the state digest unless explicitly included in the canonical state.

checkpoint_id.description: Stable identifier for a checkpoint. Implementations should use the ckpt-<sha256-hex> format defined by the architecture document.

parent_run_id.description: Identifier of the execution run that produced this checkpoint.

state_digest.description: Content digest of the complete resumable state, conventionally encoded as algorithm:digest.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time at which the checkpoint was captured.

fork_reference.description: Optional source checkpoint reference. A string is a checkpoint_id; an object carries the referenced checkpoint_id and may include a producer-supplied snapshot of that checkpoint.
